radial.controller: right stick, flick to a sign, triggers confirm

hold_or_toggle: hold (default) or toggle: press Weave once to start, again to cast

assist.prefix_hint: While weaving, the HUD lists the techniques you know that start with the signs so far (ghost signs show the rest)
assist.auto_sign: Accessibility: pick a known technique from the quick wheel and the signs play themselves at 6 ticks a sign. No fizzles, no mastery shortening
assist.sign_buffer: Inputs up to 2 ticks early are buffered, so fast typists never drop a sign

interrupt: A melee hit, a stagger or a knockdown interrupts weaving; a thrown or jutsu hit only if it deals 15% of max health or more. Story difficulty: only staggers, knockdowns and hits over 10% of max health interrupt the player

mastery.home_drill: one hand-sign drill a day at home (Shinobi Life) counts one training use for each of up to 3 techniques drilled; real fights count 2

perfected.signs: one sign (E to C: no signs)
